requirements.text: A request protected by default bearerAuth with Authorization 'Bearer alpha-._~+/=' returns HTTP 200, body 'auth', executes the downstream handler, and preserves downstream header x-custom=foo.
The default Bearer prefix is case-insensitive: bearer, BEARER, and BeArEr with the configured token each return HTTP 200 and execute the downstream handler.
A protected request without the authentication header returns HTTP 401, body Unauthorized, WWW-Authenticate 'Bearer realm=""', and does not execute downstream middleware.
An Authorization header with malformed scheme 'Beare' returns HTTP 400, body Bad Request, WWW-Authenticate 'Bearer error="invalid_request"', and does not execute downstream middleware.
A syntactically valid Bearer header with an unconfigured token returns HTTP 401, body Unauthorized, WWW-Authenticate 'Bearer error="invalid_token"', and does not execute downstream middleware.
With prefix Bot, 'Bot alpha-._~+/=' returns HTTP 200 and body 'auth bot', while the same token using prefix Bearer returns HTTP 400 and does not execute the handler.
With empty prefix and headerName X-Api-Key, the exact configured token in X-Api-Key returns HTTP 200 and body 'auth apiKey'; supplying only Authorization leaves X-Api-Key absent and returns HTTP 401.

An asynchronous verifyToken callback that accepts only path /verify and token dynamic-token returns HTTP 200 for that combination and HTTP 401 for invalid-token without executing the downstream handler.

test_cases.title: Default bearer token authorizes request
preconditions: A Hono route is protected by bearerAuth with token alpha-._~+/=.
A downstream middleware sets x-custom=foo and the handler returns auth.

steps.action: Request the protected route with the configured bearer token.
steps.expected_result: HTTP 200, body auth, x-custom foo, and downstream handler executed.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The exact configured token authorizes the request.

test_cases.title: Bearer prefix matching ignores case
preconditions: A Hono route is protected by default bearerAuth.

steps.action: Request the route once with each supported prefix casing.
steps.expected_result: Each response is HTTP 200 and executes the downstream handler.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Prefix case does not change authorization.

test_cases.title: Missing authentication header is rejected
preconditions: A Hono route is protected by default bearerAuth.

steps.expected_result: HTTP 401, body Unauthorized, WWW-Authenticate Bearer realm="", and downstream is not executed.

test_cases.expected_outcome: A missing authentication header is rejected with the source-backed challenge.

test_cases.title: Malformed authorization scheme is a bad request
preconditions: A Hono route is protected by default bearerAuth.

steps.action: Request the route with malformed scheme Beare.
steps.expected_result: HTTP 400, body Bad Request, WWW-Authenticate Bearer error="invalid_request", downstream not executed.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Malformed header syntax is distinguished from an invalid token.

test_cases.title: Unconfigured token is unauthorized
preconditions: A Hono route is protected by default bearerAuth.

steps.action: Request the route with a valid-form but unconfigured token.
steps.expected_result: HTTP 401, body Unauthorized, WWW-Authenticate Bearer error="invalid_token", downstream not executed.

test_cases.expected_outcome: A syntactically valid wrong token is rejected as invalid_token.

test_cases.title: Custom Bot prefix is enforced
preconditions: A Hono route uses bearerAuth with prefix Bot and token alpha-._~+/=.

steps.action: Request with the default Bearer prefix.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Only the configured custom prefix is accepted.

test_cases.title: Empty prefix uses custom API-key header
preconditions: A Hono route uses bearerAuth with empty prefix, headerName X-Api-Key, and token alpha-._~+/=.

steps.action: Request with the configured X-Api-Key header.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The exact custom header and prefix-free token contract is enforced.

test_cases.title: Async verifyToken controls authorization
preconditions: A Hono route uses async verifyToken that accepts only path /verify and token dynamic-token.

steps.expected_result: HTTP 401 and downstream handler not executed.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The asynchronous verifier result is authoritative.

warnings: Credential safety — all token values are deterministic public test fixtures.
Bounded scope — eight core bearer-auth variants only.
